shortBio.en: Dire Straits guitar/vocals pillar; pickless fingerstyle on Strat/Tele as the band’s identity.
shortBio.zh: Dire Straits 吉他/人声支柱；Strat/Tele 上的无拨片 fingerstyle 即乐队身份。

whyHub.en: Writer–player–producer in one: fingerstyle lead and narrative verse define Dire Straits across pub-rock to Brothers in Arms scale.
whyHub.zh: 写手–演奏–制作合一：fingerstyle 主音与叙事主歌定义 Dire Straits，从 pub-rock 到 Brothers in Arms 体量。

body.en:
Born 1949. Forms Dire Straits 1977 with David Knopfler, Illsley, Withers. Debut (1978) and Sultans of Swing cite clean Fender tone and Dorian lead lines over a tight pocket—no fuzz wall.

Making Movies (1980) and Brothers in Arms (1985) scale the same craft to MTV/stadium. After 1995 band rest, solo and soundtrack work continue the fingerstyle method.

Hub value: one guitar grammar carries the logo; lineup and production change around it.
body.zh:
1949 年生。1977 与 David Knopfler、Illsley、Withers 组建 Dire Straits。首专（1978）与 Sultans of Swing 引用干净 Fender 音色与 Dorian 主音线、紧 pocket——无 fuzz 墙。

Making Movies（1980）与 Brothers in Arms（1985）把同一手艺扩到 MTV/体育场。1995 乐队休止后，独唱与配乐延续 fingerstyle。

枢纽价值：一种吉他语法扛起 logo；阵容与制作围着它变。

note.en: Sole lead voice and primary writer through Brothers in Arms era.
note.zh: 至 Brothers in Arms 时期的唯一主唱与主笔。

note.en: Solo albums and film scores; same fingerstyle grammar.
note.zh: 独唱专集与电影配乐；同一 fingerstyle 语法。
